### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/seat-booking.txt ### Sold-out performance
state perfId="p4"
state joined=false
state joinEmail=""
Page
  Nav sticky fill=#FF120712
    Brand "Proscenium" icon="theater_comedy" color=#FFD4A64A
    Button.ghost "Back" icon="arrow_back" onTap={go production}
  Section center
    Column gap=16 center maxw=560
      Icon "event_busy" size=48 color=#FFD4A64A
      Heading "Salome, Sat 14 December, 19:30" level=1 font=serif color=#FFF5E9D0
      Badge.error "Sold out"
      Text.muted "Every seat has gone. Returned seats are released on Tuesdays at noon and we will tell you first."
      if !joined
        Input "Email" type=email @joinEmail
        Button "Join the waiting list" onTap={joined=true; emit waitlist joinEmail; toast "You are on the list"}
      if joined
        Text.success "You are on the list for this performance."
      Divider
      Text.strong "Other nights with seats"
      Row gap=8 wrap
        ChoiceChip "Thu 21 Dec, 19:30" onTap={go seats}
        ChoiceChip "Sun 24 Jan, 14:30" onTap={go seats}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/calendar-app.txt ### Calendars
state hiddenCals=[] persist
state cals=[{"id":"work","name":"Work","color":"#FF2563EB","count":14},{"id":"home","name":"Home","color":"#FF16A34A","count":5},{"id":"family","name":"Family","color":"#FFDB2777","count":7},{"id":"health","name":"Health","color":"#FFEA580C","count":3},{"id":"travel","name":"Travel","color":"#FF7C3AED","count":2},{"id":"focus","name":"Focus","color":"#FF0891B2","count":9}]
App
  Sidebar w=260 hide=tablet
    Brand "Margin" icon="calendar_month"
    NavItem "Back to calendar" icon="arrow_back" onTap={go month}
  Main
    Nav border-bottom=#FFE5E7EB
      Heading "Calendars" level=3
    Column pad=24 gap=12 maxw=560
      Text.muted "Switch a calendar off to hide its events everywhere. Your choice is remembered."
      each c in cals
        Card
          Row gap=12 middle
            Box w=14 h=14 radius=7 fill={c.color}
            Column grow
              Text.strong c.name
              Text.caption "{c.count} events"
            Toggle value={!contains(hiddenCals,c.id)} onChange={hiddenCals=result?without(hiddenCals,c.id):append(hiddenCals,c.id)}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/ereader-shelf.txt ### Reader
state page=0
state ui=false
state font="Georgia"
state size=18
state spacing=1.5
state margin=24
state hue="yellow"
state highlights=[{"id":1,"page":0,"text":"the harbor lights went out one by one","color":"yellow","note":""}]
state sel={"text":"","page":0}
state note=""
state word=""
state chapters=[{"title":"1. The Ferry at Dusk","page":0},{"title":"2. Salt and Rope","page":3},{"title":"3. A Letter Unsent","page":6},{"title":"4. The Lamp Keeper","page":9}]
state pages=["By the time the ferry reached Calder Point, the harbor lights went out one by one, as they always did when the wind turned north. Ines held the rail and counted them, a habit from childhood.","Her father had taught her to count lights the way other fathers taught their children prayers. Seven for the breakwater, four for the mill, and one, always, for the house that no longer had a name.","The deckhand coiled a rope with the slow patience of a man paid by the hour. He nodded at her bag, then at the water, and said nothing, which she took as kindness.","Salt had worked its way into everything: the bench, the buckles, the pages of the book she had not opened since Lisbon. She opened it now, and the spine cracked like a knuckle.","Chapter two began with a recipe for fish stew and ended with a confession. She read both twice.","Somewhere below, an engine changed its note. The ferry leaned toward the quay and the town came up out of the dark in pieces.","A letter lay folded in the book's back cover, addressed in a hand she knew and had hoped not to see again.","She did not open it. She set it on the bench beside her and watched the wind decide what to do.","By the time the porter arrived, the envelope was gone, and Ines found she did not mind as much as she had expected.","The lamp keeper's cottage stood at the end of the mole, its window the only square of yellow on that side of the bay.","He answered the door before she knocked, as though the knocking had been audible for years.","Come in, he said. The kettle has been waiting longer than I have."]
state defs={"quay":{"pos":"noun","def":"A platform lying alongside or projecting into water for loading and unloading ships.","ipa":"kee"},"mole":{"pos":"noun","def":"A stone structure serving as a pier or breakwater.","ipa":"mohl"},"porter":{"pos":"noun","def":"A person employed to carry luggage.","ipa":"PAWR-ter"}}
state hl=[]
state q=""
every 1s when ui==false onTick={}
App
  Main
    Nav hide=phone
      IconButton "arrow_back" tooltip="Library" onTap={go library}
      Column gap=0
        Text.strong "The Lamp Keeper's Year"
        Text.caption "Nadia Okonkwo"
      Row gap=4
        IconButton "format_list_bulleted" tooltip="Contents" onTap={open contents}
        IconButton "bookmark_border" tooltip="Bookmark this page" onTap={toast "Bookmarked page {page+1}"}
        IconButton "search" tooltip="Search in book" onTap={open bookSearch}
        IconButton "text_fields" tooltip="Display settings" onTap={ui=true; open settings}
    Stack grow
      Pages @page items=pages onSwipeLeft={page=min(page+1,length(pages)-1)} onSwipeRight={page=max(page-1,0)}
        Column pad=[margin,32,margin,32]
          SelectableText "{item}" font=font size=size lineHeight=spacing highlights={filter(highlights,h=>h.page==page)} colors={{"yellow":"#66FFEB3B","green":"#6666BB6A","blue":"#6642A5F5","pink":"#66F06292"}} onSelect={sel={"text":result.text,"page":page}; open highlightMenu} onLongPress={word=lower(result.word); open dictionary} onHighlightTap={note=result.note; sel=result; open noteEditor}
      Row
        Box w=96 h=fill onTap={page=max(page-1,0)}
        Box grow h=fill onTap={ui=!ui; ui ? open settings : close}
        Box w=96 h=fill onTap={page=min(page+1,length(pages)-1)}
    Footer
      Column gap=4 pad=[24,8,24,8]
        Progress {(page+1)/length(pages)}
        Row between
          Text.caption "{last(filter(chapters,c=>c.page<=page)).title}"
          Text.caption "{round((page+1)/length(pages)*100,0)}%  ·  page {page+1} of {length(pages)}"
  Sheet#settings "Display"
    Column gap=16
      Card gap=4
        Text "Her father had taught her to count lights the way other fathers taught their children prayers." font=font size=size lineHeight=spacing
        Text.caption "Live sample"
      Select "Typeface" @font items=["Georgia","Merriweather","Literata","Helvetica","OpenDyslexic"]
      Row gap=12
        Icon "text_decrease"
        Slider @size min=12 max=32 step=1 grow
        Icon "text_increase"
        Text.strong "{size}"
      Column gap=4
        Text.fieldLabel "Line spacing"
        SegmentedButton @spacing items=[1.2,1.5,1.8,2.1]
      Column gap=4
        Text.fieldLabel "Margins"
        Slider @margin min=8 max=64 step=4
      Row gap=8
        ChoiceChip "Paper" onTap={emit theme "paper"}
        ChoiceChip "Sepia" onTap={emit theme "sepia"}
        ChoiceChip "Night" onTap={emit theme "night"}
      Button "Done" onTap={ui=false; close}
  Menu#highlightMenu
    Row gap=8 pad=8
      IconButton "circle" color=#FFFFEB3B tooltip="Yellow" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":sel.page,"text":sel.text,"color":"yellow","note":""}); close}
      IconButton "circle" color=#FF66BB6A tooltip="Green" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":sel.page,"text":sel.text,"color":"green","note":""}); close}
      IconButton "circle" color=#FF42A5F5 tooltip="Blue" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":sel.page,"text":sel.text,"color":"blue","note":""}); close}
      IconButton "circle" color=#FFF06292 tooltip="Pink" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":sel.page,"text":sel.text,"color":"pink","note":""}); close}
    MenuItem "Highlight and add note" icon="edit_note" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":sel.page,"text":sel.text,"color":"yellow","note":""}); note=""; open noteEditor}
    MenuItem "Copy" icon="content_copy" onTap={copy sel.text; toast "Copied"}
    MenuItem "Look up" icon="menu_book" onTap={word=lower(sel.text); open dictionary}
  Dialog#noteEditor "Note" "On: {sel.text}"
    Input "Your note" @note multiline
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Remove highlight" onTap={highlights=removeWhere(highlights,h=>h.text==sel.text); close}
      Button "Save" onTap={highlights=updateWhere(highlights,h=>h.text==sel.text,h=>with(h,"note",note)); toast "Note saved"; close}
  Popover#dictionary
    Column gap=8 pad=16 w=300
      Row between
        Text.heading "{word}"
        IconButton "volume_up" tooltip="Pronounce" onTap={emit speak word}
      Text.caption "{coalesce(defs[word].pos,"")}  /{coalesce(defs[word].ipa,"")}/"
      Text "{coalesce(defs[word].def,"No entry found offline.")}"
      Row gap=8
        Button.outline "Highlight" onTap={highlights=append(highlights,{"id":length(highlights)+1,"page":page,"text":word,"color":"yellow","note":""}); close}
        Button.ghost "More" onTap={link "https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/{word}"}
  Sheet#contents "Contents"
    ListView
      each c in chapters
        ListTile "{c.title}" subtitle="Page {c.page+1}" selected={c.page<=page && (isEmpty(filter(chapters,d=>d.page>c.page && d.page<=page)))} onTap={page=c.page; close}
    Divider
    Text.sectionTitle "Highlights"
    ListView
      each h in highlights
        ListTile "{h.text}" subtitle={h.note==""?"Page {h.page+1}":h.note} onTap={page=h.page; close}
  Dialog#bookSearch "Search in book"
    Input "Search" @q
    ListView
      each p in pages
        if contains(lower(p),lower(q)) && q!=""
          ListTile "Page {index+1}" subtitle="{p}" onTap={page=index; close}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/notes-app.txt ### Workspace
state notebooks=[{"id":"all","name":"All notes","parent":""},{"id":"journal","name":"Journal","parent":""},{"id":"j24","name":"2026","parent":"journal"},{"id":"work","name":"Work","parent":""},{"id":"proj","name":"Projects","parent":"work"},{"id":"read","name":"Reading","parent":""},{"id":"recipes","name":"Recipes","parent":""}] persist
state notes=[{"id":"n1","title":"Morning pages","body":"Woke before the light and wrote three pages by hand. The trick is not to reread them.\n\nThe quiet hour is the only one that belongs to me.","nb":"j24","tags":["journal","habit"],"pinned":true,"created":"2026-11-02","edited":"2026-11-15","trashed":false},{"id":"n2","title":"Q4 planning notes","body":"Three bets for the quarter: onboarding, offline mode, and the export format.\n\nOpen question: who owns the migration?","nb":"proj","tags":["work","planning"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-10-28","edited":"2026-11-14","trashed":false},{"id":"n3","title":"On Marginalia","body":"Notes on reading with a pencil: underline sparingly, argue in the margin, and return a year later.","nb":"read","tags":["reading","habit"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-09-12","edited":"2026-11-10","trashed":false},{"id":"n4","title":"Sourdough, third attempt","body":"900g flour, 700g water, 20g salt, 180g starter. Fold every thirty minutes for three hours.","nb":"recipes","tags":["recipes","baking"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-11-01","edited":"2026-11-09","trashed":false},{"id":"n5","title":"Meeting with Priya","body":"She wants the draft by Friday. Send the outline first and ask about the budget line.","nb":"proj","tags":["work"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-11-05","edited":"2026-11-08","trashed":false},{"id":"n6","title":"Old shopping list","body":"Oats, lemons, candles, stamps.","nb":"journal","tags":[],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-08-03","edited":"2026-08-03","trashed":true}] persist
state theme="Paper" persist
state fontSize=18 persist
state sort="Edited" persist
state nb="all" persist
state openId="n1" persist
state pane="list"
state folded=[] persist
state q=""
state selecting=false
state picked=[]
state saved=true
state tagDraft=""
state tag=""
state view="workspace"
state expandedNb={}
Shortcut "mod+k" onPress={open palette}
Shortcut "mod+n" onPress={notes=append(notes,{"id":"n"+(length(notes)+1),"title":"Untitled","body":"","nb":nb=="all"?"journal":nb,"tags":[],"pinned":false,"created":today(),"edited":today(),"trashed":false}); openId="n"+(length(notes)+1); pane="note"}
App
  Sidebar w=240 border-right=#FFE3D9C3 fill=#FFF3EBDA show=desktop
    Brand "Inkwell" icon="auto_stories"
    Button "New note" icon="add" onTap={emit newNote}
    Input "Search" "Ctrl K" icon="search" readonly onTap={open palette}
    Text.caption "NOTEBOOKS"
    Tree items={notebooks} @nb parent="parent" foldable foldedBind=folded label="name" count={n=>count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (n.id=="all" || x.nb==n.id))} onSelect={nb=result; view="workspace"; pane="list"}
    Divider
    NavItem "Tags" icon="sell" selected={view=="tags"} onTap={view="tags"}
    NavItem "Trash" icon="delete" badge="{count(notes,x=>x.trashed)}" selected={view=="trash"} onTap={view="trash"}
    NavItem "Settings" icon="settings" selected={view=="settings"} onTap={view="settings"}
    Spacer grow
    Text.caption "{count(notes,x=>!x.trashed)} notes"
  Main
    Nav show=phone
      IconButton "menu" onTap={open nbSheet}
      Heading "Inkwell" level=3
      Row gap=4
        IconButton "search" onTap={open palette}
        IconButton "add" onTap={emit newNote}
    Splitter#panes
      Pane w=340 minw=260 resizable show={view=="workspace" && (pane=="list" || !phone)}
        Nav
          Heading "{first(map(filter(notebooks,x=>x.id==nb),x=>x.name))}" level=3
          Row gap=4
            Select @sort items=["Edited","Created","Title"] w=110
            IconButton "checklist" onTap={selecting=!selecting; picked=[]}
        if selecting
          Row gap=8 pad=8 fill=#FFEFE4CC
            Text.small "{length(picked)} selected"
            Spacer grow
            Button.ghost "Move" icon="drive_file_move" onTap={open moveMenu}
            Button.ghost "Tag" icon="sell" onTap={open tagPopover}
            Button.ghost "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open confirmMany}
        if count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (nb=="all" || x.nb==nb))==0
          EmptyState "This notebook is empty" "Start with a blank page." icon="edit_note"
            Button "New note" onTap={emit newNote}
        ListView scroll
          each n in sortBy(sortByDesc(filter(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (nb=="all" || x.nb==nb)),x=>sort=="Title"?0:(sort=="Created"?x.created:x.edited)),x=>x.pinned?0:1)
            ListTile selected={openId==n.id} onTap={openId=n.id; pane="note"} onLongPress={selecting=true; picked=append(picked,n.id)} menu=noteMenu
              if selecting
                Checkbox @picked value={n.id}
              Column gap=2 grow
                Row gap=6
                  if n.pinned
                    Icon "push_pin" size=14
                  Text.strong "{n.title}"
                Text.muted "{slice(n.body,0,70)}"
                Row gap=4
                  Text.caption "{formatDate(n.edited,"MMM d")}"
                  each t in n.tags
                    Chip "{t}" size=small
      Pane grow show={view=="workspace" && (pane=="note" || !phone)}
        Nav show=phone
          IconButton "arrow_back" onTap={pane="list"}
          Heading "Note" level=3
        Column pad=32 gap=12 maxw=760 scroll
          Row between
            Input.plain "Title" @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).title size=28 font="serif" weight=700 onChange={saved=false; notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"edited",today()))} debounce=600 onSaved={saved=true}
            Row gap=8
              if saved
                Row gap=4
                  Icon "check" size=14 color=#FF8A6A3D
                  Text.caption "Saved"
              if !saved
                Text.caption "Saving..."
              Toggle "Pin" @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).pinned
              IconButton "folder_open" onTap={open moveNote}
              IconButton "delete" onTap={open confirmOne}
          Row gap=6 wrap
            each t in find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).tags
              Chip "{t}" removable onRemove={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"tags",without(x.tags,t)))}
            Autocomplete "Add tag" @tagDraft suggestions={unique(concat(["journal","work","reading","recipes","planning","habit","baking"],[]))} w=160 onSubmit={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"tags",unique(append(x.tags,lower(result))))); tagDraft=""}
          Input.plain "Start writing..." multiline autogrow @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).body font="serif" size={fontSize} lineHeight=1.7 onChange={saved=false} debounce=600 onSaved={saved=true}
          Text.caption "{length(filter(split(find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).body," "),w=>w!=""))} words"
      Main grow show={view=="tags"}
        Column pad=24 gap=16
          Heading "Tags" level=1
          Row gap=8 wrap
            each t in unique(concat(map(notes,x=>x.tags[0]),[]))
              ChoiceChip "{t} {count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && contains(x.tags,t))}" selected={tag==t} onTap={tag=t}
          if tag!=""
            Heading "Notes tagged {tag}" level=3
            each n in filter(notes,x=>!x.trashed && contains(x.tags,tag))
              ListTile "{n.title}" subtitle="{formatDate(n.edited,"MMM d")}" onTap={openId=n.id; view="workspace"; pane="note"}
  Dialog#confirmOne "Move to trash?" "The note can be restored from the trash."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Move to trash" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"trashed",true)); toast "Moved to trash"; close}
  Dialog#confirmMany "Delete {length(picked)} notes?" "They go to the trash."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"trashed",true):x); picked=[]; selecting=false; close}
  Menu#moveNote
    each b in notebooks
      MenuItem "{b.name}" icon="folder" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"nb",b.id)); toast "Moved to {b.name}"}
  Menu#moveMenu
    each b in notebooks
      MenuItem "{b.name}" icon="folder" onTap={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"nb",b.id):x); picked=[]; selecting=false}
  Popover#tagPopover
    Autocomplete "Tag" @tagDraft suggestions=["journal","work","reading","recipes","planning","habit","baking"] onSubmit={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"tags",unique(append(x.tags,lower(result)))):x); tagDraft=""; picked=[]; selecting=false; close}
  Menu#noteMenu
    MenuItem "Pin" icon="push_pin" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"pinned",!x.pinned))}
    MenuItem "Move to..." icon="drive_file_move" onTap={open moveNote}
    MenuItem "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open confirmOne}
  Sheet#nbSheet "Notebooks"
    Tree items={notebooks} @nb parent="parent" foldable foldedBind=folded label="name" onSelect={nb=result; view="workspace"; pane="list"; close}
    NavItem "Tags" icon="sell" onTap={view="tags"; close}
    NavItem "Trash" icon="delete" onTap={view="trash"; close}
    NavItem "Settings" icon="settings" onTap={view="settings"; close}
